question: Does another attributed producer emit soft-pointer IMAGEDEF owners, and has ODA resolved the discrepancy between its common-object and IMAGEDEF-specific rules?

authority.finding: Section 20.1 calls the common parent a soft pointer; section 20.4.81 calls IMAGEDEF parent a hard owner. Section 2.13 identifies code 3 as hard ownership and code 12 (0xC) as a negative relative soft pointer. The official guest download inspected 2026-11-04 still identifies itself as version 5.4.1. Targeted public ODA searches found no clarifying erratum; absence of a search result does not prove none exists.

source.provenance: CAD Forum identifies this filename as a DWG2007 upload dated 2009-03-26 and publishes the same MD5. LibreDWG ChangeLog attributes the sample to cadforum.cz. Matching the published MD5 corroborates this lineage but is not a cryptographic authorship certificate. The source AppInfo claims AutoCAD 17.2.608.0 and product AutoCAD build C.608.0; it can be copied or forged, so native producer provenance is attributed, not independently authenticated. No fixture is added; source usage or redistribution permissions are not established by this observation.

independent_reader.limitations: The debug trace reports a handle-stream MISSING warning for these records, so the raw handle bits were cross-checked separately. The minJSON output is not assumed parseable JSON.

raw_bit_observation.extraction: libdxfrw fileImport retains decompressed IMAGEDEF source frames. The standalone tool walks their bits separately from the typed IMAGEDEF parser and LibreDWG; it does not independently verify compressed pages or CRC. Bit ranges are zero-based half-open within each 101-byte retained body, not offsets in the compressed on-disk DWG.
raw_bit_observation.reproduce: Verify the source SHA-256 before and after running /private/tmp/probe-ac1021-imagedef-owner <source.dwg>. Independently run the pinned dwgread command and compare its IMAGEDEF tokens. The adapter object and static library must be coherently built for the current source.

interpretation: These four AC1021 tokens are relative soft pointers, not literal role-4 tokens; the separate ODA-produced AC1024 source in p4-ac1024-imagedef-owner-role-diagnostic-2026-11-04.json uses an explicit role-4 owner. These observations conflict with the IMAGEDEF-specific hard-owner wording and cannot establish equivalence, authorize output, or promote any support claim.
next_steps: Obtain a written authoritative ODA clarification or an explicitly superseding specification resolving section 20.1 versus section 20.4.81, including whether the parent handle role may vary by DWG version and producer.

Create controlled source-only DWGs in an independently licensed AutoCAD environment from a new drawing with an IMAGE, IMAGEDEF, dictionary and reactor; record producer build, byte hashes and graph identity, and inspect literal spans with independent decoders.

Only after authoritative clarification, define the exact admitted profile, prove full IMAGE/IMAGEDEF/reactor/dictionary graph and handle-role output mapping, and validate strict ASCII/Binary output, rollback/retry and native independent readback.
constraints: No fixture was copied into the repository. The current AC1024 diagnostic remains non-promoting and no support gate was changed.
